'''Carl Mike Hardy''' (published as '''Mike Hardy''' and '''Carl "Mike" Hardy''') was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 32 FL from Pleasanton, Ca. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. He ran [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] on Tripod.

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Red 32 FL || Pleasanton, Ca || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

He was a [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 9 call-in guest on 26 February 1999, billed Mike Hardy.<ref name="rfd-09">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QU24jFxZsHM Radio Free Decipher 09], Player's Council (26 February 1999). Guests Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], Mike Hardy, and [[Guy Kargl]]. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-QU24jFxZsHM Internet Archive].</ref>

== Interviews ==

=== Radio Free Decipher, 26 February 1999 ===
Call-in guest on [[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcast 9, billed Mike Hardy, with Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], and [[Guy Kargl]]. Host [[Carol Wisely]].<ref name="rfd-09" />
